ei.title: 4번: The Two Faces of Negative Pressure
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: "Negative pressure" refers to a situation in which the pressure of an enclosed area is lower than that of the surrounding area. If the barrier between these two areas breaks, any substances in the high-pressure area will immediately flow into the low-pressure area. For example, undersea pipes used to transport oil are in a state of negative pressure; therefore, any break in the pipeline will cause it to fill with ocean water. This is much better than the opposite scenario, in which oil would be released into the ocean. However, negative pressure is not always beneficial, such as in the case of pipes carrying drinking water to a city. If these municipal waterlines are damaged, they can potentially suck in contaminated groundwater, which would then enter the water supply. For this reason, a system of gauges and valves is used to adjust and control their pressure.

questions.passage: "Negative pressure" refers to a situation in which the pressure of an enclosed area is (A)[higher / lower] than that of the surrounding area. If the barrier between these two areas breaks, any substances in the high-pressure area will (B)[slowly / immediately] flow into the low-pressure area. For example, undersea pipes used to transport oil are in a state of negative pressure; therefore, any break in the pipeline will cause it to fill with ocean water. This is much (C)[better / worse] than the opposite scenario, in which oil would be released into the ocean. However, negative pressure is not always beneficial, such as in the case of pipes carrying drinking water to a city. If these municipal waterlines are damaged, they can potentially suck in contaminated groundwater, which would then enter the water supply. For this reason, a system of gauges and valves is used to adjust and control their pressure.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) lower=더 낮은 / higher=더 높은 (B) immediately=즉시 / slowly=천천히 (C) better=더 나은 / worse=더 나쁜
det.analysis:
① higher — immediately — worse: (A) 음압은 압력이 '더 낮은(lower)' 상태 — higher는 반대
② lower — slowly — better: (B) 장벽이 깨지면 '즉시(immediately)' 흐름 — slowly는 반대
③ lower — immediately — better: 음압=압력이 더 낮음, 장벽 붕괴 시 즉시 유입, 기름 유출보다 바닷물 유입이 더 나음(better) ←정답
④ higher — slowly — worse: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 음압 정의(lower)+장벽 붕괴 시 즉각 유입(immediately)+기름 유출보다 나음(better)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) enclosed=밀폐된 / exposed=노출된 (B) transport=수송하다 / store=저장하다 (C) beneficial=유익한 / harmful=해로운

det.korean: (A) surrounding=주위의 / distant=멀리 떨어진 (B) released=방출된 / contained=억제된 (C) damaged=손상된 / repaired=수리된

④ surrounding — released — damaged: 주위 압력, 기름이 방출됨(released), 수도관이 손상됨(damaged) ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① lower=더 낮은 ② immediately→slowly (부적절) ③ better=더 나은 ④ beneficial=유익한
det.analysis:
① lower: 음압은 주변보다 압력이 낮음 — 적절
② slowly: 장벽이 깨지면 물질이 '즉시(immediately)' 흐름. slowly(천천히)는 부적절 ←정답
③ better: 기름 유출보다 바닷물 유입이 더 나음 — 적절
④ beneficial: 음압이 항상 유익하진 않음 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① enclosed=밀폐된 ② transport=수송하다 ③ contaminated→purified (부적절) ④ adjust=조절하다
det.analysis:
① enclosed: 밀폐된 공간의 압력 — 적절
② transport: 기름을 수송하는 배관 — 적절
③ purified: 손상된 수도관은 '오염된(contaminated)' 지하수를 빨아들임. purified(정화된)는 부적절 ←정답
④ adjust: 압력을 조절함 — 적절
det.tip: 손상된 수도관→오염된(contaminated) 지하수 유입. purified는 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① harmful → 원래 beneficial(유익한): 음압이 항상 '유익하진' 않다는 맥락이라 harmful은 부적절 ② municipal=시의 ③ groundwater=지하수 ④ control=통제하다
det.analysis:
① harmful: 음압이 항상 '유익하진(beneficial)' 않다는 맥락(뒤에 해로운 사례 제시). '항상 해롭진(harmful) 않다'는 부적절 ←정답
② municipal: 도시의 상수도관 — 적절
③ groundwater: 오염된 지하수를 빨아들임 — 적절
④ control: 압력을 통제함 — 적절
det.tip: 뒤에 오염수 유입(해로운 사례)이 나오므로 'not always beneficial(유익하진 않다)'가 맞음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: enclose(동사: 둘러싸다) → enclosed(과거분사: 밀폐된). 명사 area를 수식하는 과거분사
det.analysis: enclose를 과거분사 enclosed로 변환. 'an enclosed area'=밀폐된 공간. 명사(area)를 앞에서 수식하며 '둘러싸인/밀폐된' 수동 의미를 나타내므로 과거분사가 필요

questions.passage: If these municipal waterlines are damaged, they can potentially suck in __________ (contaminate) groundwater, which would then enter the water supply.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: contaminate(동사: 오염시키다) → contaminated(과거분사: 오염된). 명사 groundwater를 수식
det.analysis: contaminate를 과거분사 contaminated로 변환. 'contaminated groundwater'=오염된 지하수. 명사(groundwater)를 수식하며 '오염된' 수동 의미를 나타내므로 과거분사가 필요

questions.passage: "Negative pressure" refers to a situation in which the pressure of an enclosed area is lower than that of the surrounding area. If the barrier between these two areas breaks, any substances in the high-pressure area will immediately flow into the low-pressure area. For example, undersea pipes used to transport oil are in a state of negative pressure; therefore, any break in the pipeline will cause it to fill with __________. This is much better than the opposite scenario, in which oil would be released into the ocean. However, negative pressure is not always beneficial, such as in the case of pipes carrying drinking water to a city. If these municipal waterlines are damaged, they can potentially suck in contaminated groundwater, which would then enter the water supply. For this reason, a system of gauges and valves is used to adjust and control their pressure.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ocean water=바닷물 / drinking water=식수 / negative pressure=음압 / contaminated groundwater=오염된 지하수
det.analysis:
빈칸: 해저 송유관이 깨지면 '___로 채워진다' → 주변이 바다이므로 ocean water(바닷물)
① ocean water: 해저 배관 파손 → 바닷물 유입 ←정답
② drinking water: 식수는 도시 상수도 사례
③ negative pressure: 압력은 채워지는 물질이 아님
④ contaminated groundwater: 지하수는 도시 수도관 사례
det.tip: undersea pipe + break → fill with ocean water(바닷물)

questions.passage: "Negative pressure" refers to a situation in which the pressure of an enclosed area is lower than that of the surrounding area. If the barrier between these two areas breaks, any substances in the high-pressure area will immediately flow into the low-pressure area. For example, undersea pipes used to transport oil are in a state of negative pressure; therefore, any break in the pipeline will cause it to fill with ocean water. This is much better than the opposite scenario, in which oil would be released into the ocean. However, negative pressure is not always beneficial, such as in the case of pipes carrying drinking water to a city. If these municipal waterlines are damaged, they can potentially suck in contaminated groundwater, which would then enter the water supply. For this reason, a system of __________ is used to adjust and control their pressure.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: pipes and barriers=관과 장벽 / oil and water=기름과 물 / areas and substances=영역과 물질 / gauges and valves=계기와 밸브
det.analysis:
빈칸: 압력을 조절·통제하기 위해 쓰이는 '___의 체계' → 측정하고 여닫는 장치 = gauges and valves(계기와 밸브)
① pipes and barriers: 관과 장벽 — 조절 장치 아님
② oil and water: 기름과 물 — 운반되는 물질
③ areas and substances: 영역과 물질 — 무관
④ gauges and valves: 압력을 조절·통제하는 계기와 밸브 ←정답
det.tip: adjust and control pressure → gauges and valves(계기와 밸브)
